notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5306295/4703e5845d6a26cc120b6da65a0ecc7c94bcf38a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The update V1.01 for the Valiant Citybus Family add-on is now available. This patch focuses on bug fixes, model improvements, texture corrections, sound updates, and overall performance optimization based on community feedback.[/p][p]See the full changelog below:[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Changelog – Valiant Citybus Family V1.01[/h2][p][/p][h3]Model[/h3][list][*][p]Updated left mirror field of view for the mirror with fairing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed interior glass fittings on 7000A 3-door variant[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visible floor detail in middle left wheel arch on all articulated buses[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed floor on 7700 2-door[/p][/*][*][p]Closed buses[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing registration plate on 7000A 3-door when var_plate=1[/p][/*][*][p]Sealed hole between Webasto Kiekert doors[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Textures[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed TUV of ISAF door guide pin[/p][/*][*][p]Updated repaint template with var_paxxx=0 layer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed MPK Łódź repaint[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ceiling staying dark when interior lights are on[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Sounds[/h3][list][*][p]Replaced ventilation sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced electrical shut-off sound[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced stop request notes.title: 🚍 The new OMSI 2 Add-on Thuringian Forest is ready for departure!
notes.content:
[h1]🚌 OMSI 2 Add-on "Thuringian Forest" Announced![/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="7fry32x9GsU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Welcome to the OMSI 2 Add-on: "Thuringian Forest"![/b]
Explore a detailed, fictional map inspired by the real Thuringian Forest Nature Park along the famous Rennsteig hiking trail – featuring a variety of intercity buses with countless customization options.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Add the Add-on to your wishlist:[/b][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3181690/OMSI_2_AddOn_Thringer_Wald/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🌲 About the Region[/h2][p]The [b]Thuringian Forest[/b] is a densely wooded mountain range in central Germany, reaching heights of nearly 1,000 meters and covering around 1,000 square kilometers. Known for its rolling hills, vast spruce forests, and slate-roofed houses, this region is beautifully recreated in the add-on – down to the smallest detail.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🚌 Drive for OVR[/h2][p]Take the wheel for [b]Omnibus-Verkehr-Rennsteig GmbH (OVR)[/b] and connect even the most remote villages in the fictional landscape set around 2005. In addition to regular services, you’ll also operate [b]school bus routes[/b] and a special [b]bike & hike shuttle[/b] using a unique trailer bus combination.[/p][p]You’ll also be able to drive buses from two subcontractors:
[b]Kessler-Reisen (Bad Lemnitz)[/b] and [b]Müller-Touristik (Wurzbach)[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🚍 Included Buses[/h2][p]This add-on includes a wide selection of detailed intercity buses with full customization and authentic features:[/p][list][*][p][b]S315UL / S315UL-GT[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]S317UL Facelift / S317UL-GT Facelift[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]O550 Integro[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Each bus features multiple engine types, sound variants, gearboxes (manual, semi-automatic, automatic), and interior/exterior customization via [b]SetVar options[/b].[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🗺️ The Map[/h2][list][*][p]Fictional intercity map inspired by real locations[/p][/*][*][p]Over [b]17 km²[/b] of detailed landscape with [b]50 km of drivable roads[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]6 unique routes[/b] including school buses and seasonal special trips[/p][/*][*][p]Highly detailed environment with regional architecture and custom assets[/p][/*][*][p][b]Seasonal variations[/b], like changing crops and Christmas decorations[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🎧 Atmosphere & AI[/h2][list][*][p]New [b]passenger voices in South Thuringian dialect[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Realistic [b]AI vehicles[/b] from cars to construction trucks[/p][/*][*][p]Custom [b]RS1 train model (BR 650)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Unique soundscapes with authentic engines (OM447hLA / OM457hLA)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🔧 Highlights of Version 1.00:[/h2][list][*][p]Large, detailed map based on the Thuringian Forest around 2005[/p][/*][*][p]Unique regional buildings, roads, and vegetation[/p][/*][*][p]Intercity traffic with 4 main lines plus school and seasonal services[/p][/*][*][p]Exclusive bus models with multiple variants and configuration options[/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of new AI vehicles and a rail vehicle[/p][/*][*][p]Authentic driving experience in a beautiful low mountain landscape[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]📅 [b]Release date coming soon[/b] – stay tuned for more info!
👉 Who guessed it right? 😉[/p]

tags.feature: - Explore a detailed, fictional map inspired by the real Thuringian Forest Nature Park along the famous Rennsteig hiking trail – featuring a variety of intercity buses with countless customization options.
- Take the wheel for Omnibus-Verkehr-Rennsteig GmbH (OVR) and connect even the most remote villages in the fictional landscape set around 2005.
In addition to regular services, you’ll also operate school bus routes and a special bike & hike shuttle using a unique trailer bus combination.
You’ll also be able to drive buses from two subcontractors: Kessler-Reisen (Bad Lemnitz) and Müller-Touristik (Wurzbach).
This add-on includes a wide selection of detailed intercity buses with full customization and authentic features:
Each bus features multiple engine types, sound variants, gearboxes (manual, semi-automatic, automatic), and interior/exterior customization via SetVar options.

notes.title: OMSI 2 Add-On Citybus o530: Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5306295/6b438b1687158819a0250f11dde716bf91546f29.jpg[/img]

The OMSI 2 Add-On Citybus O530 has received a new update! 
Version 1.05 brings several improvements and bug fixes that enhance realism and ensure a smoother driving experience. 

Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented driving some articulated versions
[*] Reduced power of OM 457 engines in solo, U and MU versions
[*] Reduced bodywork gloss
[*] German license plate font has been narrowed (to fit 8 characters on plate)
[*] Double announcements (setvar) adjusted for maps with two recordings per stop
[*] Improved behavior of passengers buying a ticket at the first door
[*] Improved shadow texture under the bus

notes.title: OMSI 2 Add-on | Hohenkirchen Update
notes.content:
A new update for the OMSI 2 add-on Hohenkirchen is now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5306295/726d984852d98c0924b2c82e82b54c9eb53f6735.png[/img]

You can read the entire changelog here: 

Changelog ENG
=============
Version 1.01

Bus

- IBIS now plays a sound when the departure time is reached
- Departure request no longer has to be acknowledged on the IBIS, 
  but can also be confirmed by driving off
- Number plate of MAN A20 in EURO5 version no longer shows Berlin as default number plate
- Money from ticket purchase now remains correctly on the pay table in the IVECO articulated bus
- IVECO Urbanway now has grey walls in the interior to be closer to the real thing, 
  also textures have been optimised to make it even more performance friendly
- Interior of the MAN A20 now more appealing in terms of colouring 
- Repaint of the MAN A20 now has the matching address of the transport company

Optimisations / Map

- Added more (pre-)wayfinding signs in the intercity area
- New and updated advertisements for the passenger information display in the bus interior
- Outdated advertisements at modern bus stop buildings replaced by up-to-date advertisements
- KI traffic improved in various areas 
  (Altenheim Merz / Moritzhallstr. in Herrenhof and at Hohenkirchen station)
- Some areas that are too narrow have been alleviated by means of alternative bays or by relocating stop lines at traffic lights.

Corrections

- Bus blockades near the museum of culture should no longer exist
- Problem fixed, where the money given for ticket sales was floating around wildly in the IVECO
- Small constructional bugs fixed, among others the disappearing clock at the south station, 
  floating text field in Hohenkirchen and crooked houses in Treppendorf
- Problem solved where (with certain settings) few but important objects were no longer displayed
- Problem solved where under certain circumstances the AI cars generated errors, 
  if the add-on "Enhanced Environment Pack" had been installed

... as well as many other smaller adjustments, corrections and improvements, which would go beyond the limits here...


Version 2.00

New features
- Express bus line X49 and revised timetable for line 849
- Line 853 to the Hohenkirchen area
- Two city bus lines (1 & 2) for Hohenkirchen
- Completely revised timetable with more route changes and service journeys
- Adjustment of journey times on all lines
- Revised route 852 with new routing
- Advertising repaints for all supplied buses
- Special announcements
- New textures and customised sound for the included AI train
- Timetables as PDF for all lines
- Manual v2.0 in German and English

Corrections
- AI traffic, traffic flow and priority rules optimised at various points
- More passengers on school buses and on the Hohenkirchen <> Herrenhof connection
- Routing and design optimised in the Hohenkirchen, Rasenweg area
- Minor redesigns at Hohenkirchen railway station
- Flickering bushes reduced
- Further potholes added in places
- Extension of the design around Gasthof Dernau to include a neighbouring village
- Rail replacement services now signpost properly
- All announcements should now also be played in buses that are not included
- Many other corrections and adjustments

Bus Urbanway 18
- New, more realistic brake script 
- Metro version added (entry at all doors)
- Automatic door system also works with release still engaged
- Stop request logic revised/corrected
- Stop request buttons front and rear trigger separate stop request
- Doors can now only be opened/closed when stationary
- General bug fixing scripts

Note: 
Due to the expansion of the map, a new Hof file (Hohenkirchen_V2.0.hof) has become necessary, which can be found in the supplied buses.

notes.title: OMSI 2 Tools - AUXI Expansion Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5306295/a6c326f23b7e5888b14fc73a291ff8f421e891bc.jpg[/img]

A new OMSI 2 Tools - AUXI Expansion Update is available now!

Version 1-10
------------
Overhauled HUD:
- Extra HUD item for 'passenger count'
- Extra HUD detail in 'next stop name' for 'distance to next stop in meters' 
- Extra HUD item for 'fuel remaining %
- Optionally skip bus stops under certain conditions
- Change TTS announcer voice to another compatible voice
- TTS announcer can also announce when the bus is arriving at the next bus stop
- Extra HUD item for 'bus stop relative heading'
- Extra HUD item for 'outside temperature'

See manual for more details

Fixes
- Fixed an issue where an incorrect file name would be shown in the LUA console after loading an LUA script for the first time
- Fixed an issue with validating the latitude and longitude values of the real weather settings
- Fixed a potential conflict with Track IR
- Fixed an incompatibility with a DLC where the bus stop request HUD item wasn't flashing when it should
- Fixed an issue where the driver cameras were still being handled by AUXI even though AUXI was closed
- Fixed an issue with languages where when macros were involved sometimes the macros would get stuck
- Various other miscellaneous fixes 

Others
- Spanish translations 
- Manual V 1.1 ENG / V1.1 DE


Version 1-20
------------
- Discord rich presence
	Show to other Discord users what you're doing in OMSI. The name of the bus you're driving, the map you're driving on, the next bus stop time and name, passenger count and more.
- Driver seat adjustment settings are now unique to each bus
	You can now adjust the position depending on the bus you're driving and only have that specific configuration for that specific bus.
- Hide all visible HUD items with a single menu item
	For example if you're taking a screenshot you can hide all of AUXI's currently shown HUD items temporarily (note: this won't also hide AUXI's main UI).
- HUD items can now be locked
	This means that they won't be able to take any focus from mouse clicks or mouse hovers while locked.
	They will still show on the screen but can't be interacted with (except for Next Bus Stop as it has a button to skip bus stops).
- HUD items automatically lock if mouse control is enabled in OMSI
	This means that HUD items won't potentially disrupt those using a mouse to drive in OMSI.
- Driver statistics entries are now capped at 250
	Older entries will be deleted first if this cap is exceeded, a cap exists in the interest of maintaining an acceptable performance when viewing your driver statistics.
- Code modernisation, much of the code has undergone some tidying and modernisation work
- Showing or hiding HUD items will no longer also close the HUD submenu each time
- Changed autosave timer in AUXI from every 60 seconds to every 20 seconds
- Time synchronisation no longer shows the date and instead only the time
- HUD items no longer show on ALT+TAB (task switching)
- Reliable version detection of OMSI has been implemented. Only OMSI version 2.2.032 is supported!
- Updated translations
- Dropped Steamworks.NET as it's no longer required or used by AUXI
- Various bugs fixed
- Manual V 1.2 ENG / V1.2 DE


Version 1-30
------------
- AI scheduler
    - Added column for controlling maximum number of cars
    - Added column for controlling maximum number of humans
    - Added column for controlling the globals.cfg traffic multiplier
    - Added column for controlling the globals.cfg humans multiplier
    - Added ability to load and save presets
- Bus colour scheme [NEW]
    - Change the repaint of the bus almost instantly without needing to respawn the bus again
- Cruise control [NEW]
    - Give your foot a rest on a long motorway/highway and enable cruise control to automatically control the throttle and maintain the current speed
        - Note: This may not work well with buses that have a manual gearbox
        - Note: Tapping the brakes more than 5% will deactivate cruise control
- Driver Seat
    - Lean forward with an assignable hotkey, handy at junctions where you can't quite see the view you'd like. The amount you lean forward is also customisable per bus
    - Zoom hold with an assignable hotkey. The amount you zoom is also customisable per bus
    - Added head tilt setting per bus (up/down)
    - Added lean forward customisable setting
    - Added zoom hold customisable setting
- Hotkeys [NEW]
    - Added more than two dozen customisable hotkeys for managing various  AUXI features and OMSI 2
- HUD
    - Added brake bar HUD item
    - Added cruise control HUD item
    - Added gear number HUD item
    - Added throttle bar HUD item
    - Changed style of HUD items which have a progress bar
- Weather
    - Added seasonal dynamic weather modes
        - Spring
        - Summer
        - Autumn
        - Winter
    - Dynamic weather modes now enforce the season on any map, applying the appropriate textures for that season (changes to this setting don’t take effect while a map is currently loaded)
    - Changes in weather are even more gradual and are based on the update interval. For example, if the update interval is 10 minutes then when a weather update is fetched the weather will gradually change over the next 10 minutes from the current weather to the recently fetched weather
    - Weather no longer needs to disabled in AUXI in order to change the mode
- Added some OMSI script variables for managing some features in AUXI, please see the manual for more details
- Configuration file has been overhauled to simplify implementing new settings in the future, sadly this means your current configuration will be reset to default settings. The new configuration file is now located in the AUXI folder and is created when AUXI is first started
- Fixed various bugs
- Updated translations
- Manual ver 1.3 ENG / ver 1.3 DE


Version 1-31
------------
- AI Scheduler's logic has been rewritten from scratch, this will also hopefully address an issue where there might have been an increase in passengers since version 1.3
- Dynamic weather may now appear to be a little less biased and ideally more random
- Time synchronisation's logic has been rewritten mostly from scratch
- Cruise control is a little more aggressive at maintaining the current speed
- Bus repaint number input field is no longer limited to values between -255 and 255
- Some bug fixes
- Possible performance improvement


Version 1-311
-------------
- Fixing long loading times for certain maps


Version 1-312
-------------
- Increased the thread priority for handling the driver's camera
- Fixed an issue with inconsistent numerical format in AUXI's bus camera configuration files (originally depending on region of the PC)
- Fixed an issue where AUXI didn't ignore commented cameras in an OMSI 2 bus file
- Restored some LUA script files for Developer Tools which were missing in the previous version


Version 1-40
------------
- Added feature to modify Discord Rich Presence 'details' message (default: "%map_name% | %vehicle_name%")
- Added macro %map_name% for Discord Rich Presence messages
- Added macro %vehicle_name% for Discord Rich Presence messages
- Added feature to enable or disable OMSI logging to its file
- Added feature to change bus stop distance radius to a value between 5 meters and 60 meters (default: 60 meters, which is OMSI 2’s default range)
- Disabled auto time sync by default
- Updating the documentation

tags.feature: - Extra HUD detail in 'next stop name' for 'distance to next stop in meters'
- Optionally skip bus stops under certain conditions
- Change TTS announcer voice to another compatible voice
- TTS announcer can also announce when the bus is arriving at the next bus stop
- Extra HUD item for 'bus stop relative heading'

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where an incorrect file name would be shown in the LUA console after loading an LUA script for the first time
- Fixed an issue with validating the latitude and longitude values of the real weather settings
- Fixed a potential conflict with Track IR
- Fixed an incompatibility with a DLC where the bus stop request HUD item wasn't flashing when it should
- Fixed an issue where the driver cameras were still being handled by AUXI even though AUXI was closed
- Fixed an issue with languages where when macros were involved sometimes the macros would get stuck
- Various other miscellaneous fixes

tags.feature:
- Discord rich presence
	Show to other Discord users what you're doing in OMSI. The name of the bus you're driving, the map you're driving on, the next bus stop time and name, passenger count and more.

- Driver seat adjustment settings are now unique to each bus
	You can now adjust the position depending on the bus you're driving and only have that specific configuration for that specific bus.

- Hide all visible HUD items with a single menu item
	For example if you're taking a screenshot you can hide all of AUXI's currently shown HUD items temporarily (note: this won't also hide AUXI's main UI).

- HUD items can now be locked
	This means that they won't be able to take any focus from mouse clicks or mouse hovers while locked.
	They will still show on the screen but can't be interacted with (except for Next Bus Stop as it has a button to skip bus stops).

- HUD items automatically lock if mouse control is enabled in OMSI
	This means that HUD items won't potentially disrupt those using a mouse to drive in OMSI.

tags.balance_change:
- Driver statistics entries are now capped at 250
	Older entries will be deleted first if this cap is exceeded, a cap exists in the interest of maintaining an acceptable performance when viewing your driver statistics.

tags.feature: - Code modernisation, much of the code has undergone some tidying and modernisation work
- Showing or hiding HUD items will no longer also close the HUD submenu each time

tags.balance_change: - Changed autosave timer in AUXI from every 60 seconds to every 20 seconds

tags.feature: - Time synchronisation no longer shows the date and instead only the time

- Various bugs fixed

tags.feature:

    - Added column for controlling the globals.cfg traffic multiplier
    - Added column for controlling the globals.cfg humans multiplier
    - Added ability to load and save presets

- Bus colour scheme [NEW]
    - Change the repaint of the bus almost instantly without needing to respawn the bus again

- Cruise control [NEW]
    - Give your foot a rest on a long motorway/highway and enable cruise control to automatically control the throttle and maintain the current speed
        - Note: This may not work well with buses that have a manual gearbox
        - Note: Tapping the brakes more than 5% will deactivate cruise control

- Driver Seat
    - Lean forward with an assignable hotkey, handy at junctions where you can't quite see the view you'd like. The amount you lean forward is also customisable per bus
    - Zoom hold with an assignable hotkey. The amount you zoom is also customisable per bus
    - Added head tilt setting per bus (up/down)
    - Added lean forward customisable setting
    - Added zoom hold customisable setting

- Hotkeys [NEW]
    - Added more than two dozen customisable hotkeys for managing various  AUXI features and OMSI 2

    - Added cruise control HUD item

    - Added throttle bar HUD item

    - Added seasonal dynamic weather modes

    - Dynamic weather modes now enforce the season on any map, applying the appropriate textures for that season (changes to this setting don’t take effect while a map is currently loaded)
    - Changes in weather are even more gradual and are based on the update interval. For example, if the update interval is 10 minutes then when a weather update is fetched the weather will gradually change over the next 10 minutes from the current weather to the recently fetched weather
    - Weather no longer needs to disabled in AUXI in order to change the mode

The OMSI 2 add-on MAN Standardbus II is now available on Steam!

You can now experience the Standard II buses from MAN on your PC. The "MAN Standardbus II" add-on for OMSI 2 includes the "MAN SÜ242" intercity bus, the "MAN SL202" city bus and the "MAN SG292" articulated city bus built in 1992. With over 30 years under their belts, these are now real old-timers.
Thanks to their modular design, all vehicles can be individually adapted. Doors, destination and interior displays, gearbox and engine variants, lighting or instrument panel - over 20 customization options per vehicle allow the player to create their dream vehicle.
City and city articulated buses are also available with individual interior variants (with or without multi-purpose area for bulky goods, wheelchairs, bicycles or baby carriages) as well as seat variants (individual seats or bench seats). All vehicles are ready for use with a city bus front mask (large matrix box, two windscreens) as well as with the interurban front mask (StÜLB, small matrix box, one-piece windscreen).

notes.title: OMSI Hohenkirchen | Update Version 1-01
notes.content:
We would like to thank you for the (extremely positive) feedback so far.
Nevertheless, we have received some comments, some of which have now been adapted and corrected in version 1-01 of OMSI Hohenkirchen.

The development team continues to work on optimisations and additions, but these will take some time. With version 1-01, functions in the buses and equipment of the map will be adjusted, among other things.

The following is a more detailed list in the changelog.

[b]Version 1.01[/b]

Bus

[list]
[*] IBIS now plays a sound when the departure time is reached.
[*] Departure request no longer has to be acknowledged on the IBIS,
[*] but can also be confirmed by driving off.
[*] License plate of MAN A20 in EURO5 version no longer shows Berlin as default number plate
[*] Money from ticket purchase now remains correctly on the pay table in the IVECO articulated bus
[*] IVECO Urbanway now has grey walls in the interior to be closer to the real thing,
[*] in addition, it has become even more performance-friendly due to texture optimisations
[*] The interior of the MAN A20 now has a more appealing colour scheme
[*] Repaint of the MAN A20 now has the matching address of the transport operator
[/list]

Optimisations / Map

[list]
[*] Added more (pre-)wayfinding signs in the intercity.
[*] New and updated advertisements for the passenger information display in the interior of the buses
[*] Outdated advertisements on modern bus stop buildings replaced by up-to-date advertisements
[*] AI traffic improved in various areas
[*] (Altenheim Merz / Moritzhallstr. in Herrenhof and at Hohenkirchen station)
[*] Some areas that are too narrow have been alleviated by means of alternative bays or by relocating stop lines at traffic lights.
[/list]

Corrections

[list]
[*] Bus blockades near the cultural museum should no longer occur.
[*] Problem fixed where the money given for ticket sales was floating around wildly in the IVECO
[Fixed small constructional bugs, among others the sunken clock at the south station,
[*] free-floating text field in Hohenkirchen and crooked houses in Treppendorf
[*] Problem fixed where (with certain settings) few but important objects were no longer displayed
[*] Problem fixed where under certain circumstances the AI cars generated errors,
[*] if the add-on "Enhanced Environment Pack" had been installed
[/list]

... as well as many other minor adjustments, corrections and improvements that would go beyond the scope of this article...

The current version of the extension can be seen in the version file in the OMSI add-on directory or in the OMSI selection menu in the preview image of the add-on.
If the update does not take place automatically, you can also carry it out manually.
To do this, click in the Library - > Downloads area and then on the right-hand button next to OMSI to start the download manually.

Miscelaneous enhancements by ADIC

IMPORTANT NOTE
In V1.0 through to 2.0, the Hybrid buses were a setvar. Which meant you could drive a Diesel bus with the appearance of an Hybrid bus and vice versa.
Now the Hybrid bus has its standlone model.cfg file which means the following changes:
SETVAR hybride has been deleted

All interior configuration SETVAR are carried over to the hybrid bus appart from the following
-ver_sieges_av = 3 is not available
-ver_volant has been deleted

-vis_ga has been deleted

notes.title: Halycon / OMSI Tools AUXI - Update 1.30
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2126130/OMSI_2_Tools__AUXI_Expansion/

[b]Changelog Version 1-3[/b]

[b]AI scheduler[/b]
    - Added column for controlling maximum number of cars
    - Added column for controlling maximum number of humans
    - Added column for controlling the globals.cfg traffic multiplier
    - Added column for controlling the globals.cfg humans multiplier
    - Added ability to load and save presets

[b]Bus colour scheme [NEW][/b]
    - Change the repaint of the bus almost instantly without needing to respawn the bus again

[b]Cruise control [NEW][/b]
    - Give your foot a rest on a long motorway/highway and enable cruise control to automatically control the throttle and maintain the current speed
        - Note: This may not work well with buses that have a manual gearbox
        - Note: Tapping the brakes more than 5% will deactivate cruise control

[b]Driver Seat[/b]
    - Lean forward with an assignable hotkey, handy at junctions where you can't quite see the view you'd like. The amount you lean forward is also customisable per bus
    - Zoom hold with an assignable hotkey. The amount you zoom is also customisable per bus
    - Added head tilt setting per bus (up/down)
    - Added lean forward customisable setting
    - Added zoom hold customisable setting

[b]Hotkeys [NEW][/b]
    - Added more than two dozen customisable hotkeys for managing various  AUXI features and OMSI 2

[b]HUD[/b]
    - Added brake bar HUD item
    - Added cruise control HUD item
    - Added gear number HUD item
    - Added throttle bar HUD item
    - Changed style of HUD items which have a progress bar

        - Summer
        - Autumn

- Fixed various bugs
- Updated translations

notes.title: Halycon / OMSI Tools AUXI - Update 1.20
notes.content:
Changelog: 
[list][*]Discord rich presence
- Show to other Discord users what you're doing in OMSI. The name of the bus you're driving, the map you're driving on, the next bus stop time and name, passenger count and more.
[*]Driver seat adjustment settings are now unique to each bus
- You can now adjust the position depending on the bus you're driving and only have that specific configuration for that specific bus.
[*]Hide all visible HUD items with a single menu item
- For example if you're taking a screenshot you can hide all of AUXI's currently shown HUD items temporarily (note: this won't also hide AUXI's main UI).
[*]HUD items can now be locked
- This means that they won't be able to take any focus from mouse clicks or mouse hovers while locked.
- They will still show on the screen but can't be interacted with (except for Next Bus Stop as it has a button to skip bus stops).
[*]HUD items automatically lock if mouse control is enabled in OMSI
- This means that HUD items won't potentially disrupt those using a mouse to drive in OMSI.
[*]Driver statistics entries are now capped at 250
- Older entries will be deleted first if this cap is exceeded, a cap exists in the interest of maintaining an acceptable performance when viewing your driver statistics.
[*]Code modernisation, much of the code has undergone some tidying and modernisation work
[*]Showing or hiding HUD items will no longer also close the HUD submenu each time
[*]Changed autosave timer in AUXI from every 60 seconds to every 20 seconds
[*]Time synchronisation no longer shows the date and instead only the time
[*]HUD items no longer show on ALT+TAB (task switching)
[*]Reliable version detection of OMSI has been implemented. Only OMSI version 2.2.032 is supported!
[*]Updated translations
[*]Dropped Steamworks.NET as it's no longer required or used by AUXI
[*]Various bugs fixed
[*]Manual V 1.2 ENG / V1.2 DE
[/list]

notes.title: OMSI 2 Add-on Thüringer Wald | Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to the Thuringian Forest Nature Park on the Rennsteig![/b]

The Thuringian Forest is a densely wooded low mountain range in the Free State of Thuringia in the heart of Germany, rising to just under 1000 m above sea level and covering a good 1000 square kilometres. Characteristic features of the Thuringian Forest are the hilly relief typical of low mountain ranges, the exceptionally monotonous spruce vegetation and the slate-covered houses. 

Omnibus-Verkehr-Rennsteig GmbH (OVR) has taken on the task of driving to even the most remote villages in the fictional scenery of the Thuringian Forest in OMSI 2 and bringing passengers safely to their destination. For this purpose, you have the opportunity to explore the Thuringian Forest on eight varied routes in the matching intercity bus of the type S 315 UL in the most diverse variants!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5306295/9c464b36dd018062c1394f28317ee1cad531924d.png[/img]

[b]Highlights of this Version:[/b]
[list]
[*] Large detailed map of motifs of the Thuringian Forest around the year 2005 - huge pool of own, regionally typical objects and roads.
[*] Realistic intercity traffic with eight routes, including school bus routes and seasonal special services
[*] Exclusively developed intercity bus of the type S 315 UL (-GT) with numerous customisation options - many newly developed AI road vehicles and an AI rail vehicle (BR 650)
[/list]

[b]List of Features and Contents:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fictitious interurban map designed according to original motifs with a landscape size of over 18 km² and almost 50 km of drivable route.
[*] Eight lines with mostly individual routes, including school bus, regular and seasonal special services with journey times between 15 and 35 minutes

notes.title: OMSI 2 Add-on Studio Polygon 400 MMC Pack | Update 1.2 & 1.21
notes.content:
Welcome to the 400MMC 1.2 update! This update packs a lot into the 400MMC with an overhauled model, new variants, new features and much more. 

Below is a brief list of the key changes in this version, further below is the full change log for this version.

If you find any issues, please open a support ticket with us on our Discord server and we can rectify the issue for you: https://discord.com/invite/DxsNYHPd4V

The LHD variants have been removed in this update so that we can focus on resolving all issues on the RHD variants first and then work on the LHD variants. These will follow in a future update in the near future.

[b]400MMC 1.2 Key Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked interior and exterior model.
[*] New ADL Smartseats seating option for all variants.
[*] Overhauled cab area and dashboard on both ADL and Scania variants.
[*] Reworked gearbox and engine performance on all variants.
[*] Addition of new Low Height variants.
[*] Enhanced Ticketer features.
[*] New Hanover controller functionality.
[*] New SPID system with more customisability.
[*] New staircase options.
[*] Various new customisability setvars.
[*] Performance improvements.
[/list]

[b]400MMC 1.2 Full Changelog[/b]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[u]Common:[/u]
[list]
[*] Add ADL Smartseats
[*] Remodel front bumper and lower windscreen.
[*] Remodel cab mouldings.
[*] Retextured entire dashboard.
[*] Remodel steering column.
[*] Remodel cab rear view mirror.
[*] Rescript entire DG3 functionality.
[*] Rescript wiper functionality
[*] New SPID system and more customisability options.
[*] Add new staircase options setvar.
[*] Add new upper deck skylights setvar.
[*] Add new nearside destination display setvar. Allowing for either a lower or upper placement.
[*] New and improved HANCIS interior LED display system.
[*] Retexture exterior camera mirrors.
[*] Add new full rear display setvar (what Stagecoach use)
[*] Add reverse gear interlock (press the interlock switch before reverse to allow reverse gear to engage).
[*] Add defect card setvar.
[*] Add handbrake label.
[*] Add re-worked seating with lower poly count.
[*] Add assault alarm cancel switch.
[*] Add correct N250UD and E40D engine bay textures.
[*] Add new interior Studio Polygon advertising, replacing standard First.
[*] New Studio Polygon interior.
[*] Add envmap to interior stopping panels.
[*] Add missing door light by front seats.
[*] Add exterior flaps setvar for fuel and adblue.
[*] Add CabDecals setvar. (Allows the default cab decals to be hidden: height marker, mirror overhang etc)
[*] Wheelchair ramp now alters angle based on height from the kerb to prevent the ramp clipping into the kerb and is now flush.
[*] Add ability to open ticket bin.
[*] Add ability to open the battery bay.
[*] New frits texture.
[*] New cash tray texture.
[*] Add coolant level indicator.
[*] Retexture upper deck front window pole and add more detail.
[*] Slight remodel of upper deck front mouldings.
[*] Add missing interior rear door close button on dual door variants.
[*] Door flaps randomly get stuck.
[*] Add cup holder to cab door.
[*] Feature improvements to the Wayfarer 150 and iBus MDT.
[/list]

[u]ADL:[/u]
[list]
[*] Add ADL 11.5m Low Height variant.
[*] Remodel steering wheel.
[*] Remodel indicator stalk.
[*] Add additional ADL rear badge setvar for the middle of the engine bay.
[*] Add station brake behaviour.
[*] Add engine wait to start.
[*] Add battery charge warning lights.
[*] New ADL hazard switch lighting.
[*] Add engine idle cutout.
[*] New dashboard lights.
[*] Add London running boards setvar.
[/list]

[u]Scania:[/u]
[list]
[*] Add Scania 11.4m Low Height variant
[*] Add ability to change dash brightness.
[*] Remodel cab mouldings to match real life shape.
[*] Offset dashboard as per real life.
[*] Add Scania “Lighting active” screen.
[*] Scania horn sounds if engine on with master off and handbrake off.
[*] Scania requires the handbrake to be engaged to engage gear.
[*] Airport specification now has all seating variants, not just highbacks.
[/list]

[u]Ticketer:[/u]
[list]
[*] Add messaging functionality.
[*] Add delay text to in motion screen on Ticketer.
[*] Add “Loading ticket information” screen when loading ticket selling screen.
[*] Screen adjustment and arm adjustment are now separated allowing for better screen adjustment.
[*] Add duty totals on top of the existing trip totals.
[*] Driver summary is now printed when logging off.
[/list]


[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced texture footprint for dashboard items.
[*] Reduce polygon count on interior vents.*
[*] Move interior light connector pieces to ceiling template.*
[*] Change how dash switches are textured to aid texture space usage.
[*] Retexture main cab mouldings.
[*] Consolidate many meshes to slightly improve loading times.
[*] Various model improvements to shading.
[*] Rework interior lighting system.
[*] Increase envmap on exterior body.
[*] Optimise engine bay textures.
[*] Remap interior ads to remove redundant “frames” texture.
[*] Add ability to adjust dashboard while engine on, but must be in neutral.
[*] Revamp dash screen icons to more realistic behaviour.
[*] Modified exterior glass tint.
[*] ADL headlights turn off if the engine is off.
[*] Odometer now randomises to a more realistic figure.
[*] Interior lights can be turned on if ignition off.
[*] Rework some London interior decals.
[/list]

[u]Ticketer:[/u]
[list]
[*] Retexture Ticketer model while optimising texture usage.
[*] Modify design of Ticketer screens to more accurately represent the real-life counterpart.
[*] Change Ticketer issue button to Ready if no passengers are onboard.
[*] New Ticketer typeface.
[*] Pressing “End Trip” in the options menu now redirects to trip selection instead of duty summary.
[*] Logging out will now automatically end the trip.
[/list]


[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix front door arms clipping with interior ceiling.
[*] Fix Stop light on ADL variants incorrectly displaying.
[*] Fix indicator colour showing on brake lights when using the halo lights.*
[*] Fix seating clipping with upper deck walls.
[*] Fix interior glass by front seats clipping through the ceiling.
[*] Fix ad board by front passenger seat clipping with speaker.
[*] Fix mirrors on AI variants not displaying if an invalid setvar value is entered.
[*] Fix small holes in upper deck front mouldings by the panel gaps.
[*] Fix hole in chassis by exhaust.
[*] Low air pressure sound only now sounds with engine running.
[*] Fix Hanover flashing when changing page.
[/list]

[u]Ticketer:[/u]
[list]
[*] Fix Ticketer delay state being backwards.
[*] Initialisation fixes to further reduce bugs caused for users using Bus Company Simulator.
[*] Resetting the passenger occupancy to 0 now resets the wheelchair status.
[*] Returning to the ticket selling screen from any other screen resets the ticket selection to the first page.
[*] Ending the trip from the options page will now reset trip totals.
[*] Pressing back from the duty selection screen will now log out.
[/list]


[b]Removes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed animated rain to improve performance and looks.
[*] Removed VIX TP5800 and Almex Optima ticket machine options.
[*] Removed LHD variants (will be re-added in a near future update)
[*] Removed smashable glass.
[*] Binnacle lights for stop request no longer function - uses the side panel as per irl.
[*] Removed clutter.
[*] Removed random VOR slip.
[*] BCR card
[/list]


---

[list]

[*] Add paint.net compatible templates.

[*] Fix not being able to use rear aircon vent setvar with full rear display.
[*] Fix staircase pole bake on low height variants.

notes.title: Studio Polygon Lite Pack Update 1.2
notes.content:
A new update for the Studio Polygon Lite is here!

Version 1.2 of the Lite introducs 8 completely new London variants with realistic Wayfarer 150, iBus and Smartblind systems to match. It also includes a completely new and even detailed interior and exterior model. 

Furthermore, an emphasis on customizability was added. This version has over 40 setvars so you can customise your Lite to match even the most unique specification of a vehicle in the real-world. 

Apart from improved texturing throughout, 250+ new sounds, hyper-realistic system simulation and refined vehicle physics, a huge emphasis on overall performance was added. 

Enjoy the update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5306295/1b1354dc6a29e3f65a77959b08284047320214f6.png[/img]

notes.title: Coming Soon: The Bus (Early Access)
notes.content:
Dear OMSI Community,

have you heard the news already? On Thursday, 25th March 2021, the next generation of city bus driving simulation releases: The Early Access version of TML-Studio's The Bus!

Transport passengers on different lines across the capital city of Germany, Berlin, on a realistic track layout in the scale of 1:1 with various busses.

There are further information on the The Bus Steam page: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/491540/The_Bus/

Moreover, you can find a general roadmap for the development of The Bus during its Early Access there as well. As you may notice from the name, Thurday will be the beginning of a long collective journey: numerous features and improvements will follow in the future.

Here are some highlights of the roadmap:

Phase 1.0 (available at the start of the Early Access of The Bus)

[list]
[*]     Bus line TXL with various routes
[*]     Two bus variants: Articulated and Solo
[*]     Passenger ticket sale
[/list]

Phase 2.0

[list]
[*]     The Bus Modding Tools for Unreal Engine 4 Game Editor
[*]     Multiplayer mode for Freeplay
[*]     Addtional bus line 100 and 200 with various routes
[*]     AI busses
[/list]

Phase 3.0 

[list]
[*] Economy mode
[*] Additional bus line 245 with various routes
[*] Complete tutorial and checklists
[/list]

Now, we would like to know from you how we can improve The Bus in your opinion. What makes the gaming experience more realistic for you? What are your wishes? What do you love about OMSI 2 that could be integrated into The Bus as well? What bothers you (e.g. about the driving dynamics)?

Accompany us on our way to the final bus simulator The Bus!

We are looking forward to your feedback and are happy to discuss with you in a civilized way.
It would be best if you would join the TML Discord to do so: https://discord.com/invite/vkqyQ7TbDU

We are looking forward to your constructive criticism!

notes.title: DLC E-Bus Hamburg available now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1317200/OMSI_2_AddOn_EBus_Hamburg/

Vision becomes reality – after the first battery electric buses of the type eCitaro have been standardly put in operation in Hamburg in summer 2018, this modern city bus now finds its way into OMSI 2 as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5306295/3d6001af34658943b7d549696d7a777f6c3d11cd.jpg[/img]

Currently, there are already 20 vehicles of this type in use in Hamburg (state April 2020) and you can find them also in other German cities like Berlin.

All the special features of the original can be virtually discovered here like cornering light, automatic light, rain sensor, the new interior design, features of the high voltage electrical system and much more. Of course, compressor, air-condition, and power steering are completely operated by electricity, too. You will notice this in the bus’s behaviour and sound. In comparison to the add-on “Hamburg Buses”, 44 new sounds have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5306295/91c0b731e3cff20e3ec821968cb68b9c3c4d9bde.png[/img]

In addition to the known Hamburg ticket printer and LED destination display, the e-buses have a two-part widescreen passenger display and the Validation- and Sales-System (PVS) with which the passengers can check their digital tickets.

The vehicle’s implementation into the game is based on original training documents of the HOCHBAHN and on experiences in the regular service. You can even charge the bus in the bus depot by using the standard “refuel” button in OMSI 2. This looks best if you are standing under a carport with a charging cable like in the map Hamburg HafenCity. Of course, the add-on also includes some close to reality versions of paint from all over Germany, as well as 4K repaint templates for your own advertisement.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list][*]New 2019 interior design
[*]High detailed mesh with 2K and optionally 4K textures
[*]Realistic high voltage system with power and SOC display
[*]SOS lighting function
[*]44 new sounds

notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/708173/OMSI_2_Addon_BremenNord/

[h1]Changelog v1-011[/h1]
[list][*]Erroneous tile files deleted[/list]

[h1]Changelog v1-012[/h1]
[list][*]Fix: ticket pack (connection ticket is no longer sold)
[*]Fix: Auxiliary arrow on the community center is no longer blocked by trees
[*]Fix: Floating backdrop on the freeway in the Aumund area
[*]Fix: Entrypoint "Buschdeel" made available for all years
[*]Fix: Chrono "Track changes": stop sign "Bf Turnerstr." Towards Bf Blumenthal is again inscribed
[*]Fix: Haven Höövt Boundingbox
[*]Fix: Station Link: Bf Vegesack => Bf Vegesack WP Platform 3 Exterior
[*]Fix: Positions of the bus cube "Ermlandstrasse exit" and depot waiting position changed
[*]Fix: Request distance traffic light BF Blumenthal changed
[*]Overview CTI changed
[*]New: Gulls group added
[*]New: Entrypoint "Borchsholt"
[*]New: preparations for New Year's Eve / New Year
[*]New: different graphic settings available[/list]

[h1]Changelog v1-021[/h1]

[b]Large Texture Update:[/b]
In this patch we provide a LowRes texture for each object.
LowRes means that the texture of the object is downgraded and thus looks washed out. This doesn't look well, but it saves a lot of texture memory.
This feature is optimal for weaker PC systems and can greatly improve performance. You can activate the low res textures in the OMSI settings.

[b]Map & Other:[/b]
[list][*]New: Manual in English version 1.0 included
[*]New: Announcements "An der Lehmkuhle" and "Bf Turnerstr." added
[*]New: Entrypoint "Bf Turnerstr."
[*]New: Extra stop for leaving the Bf Vegesack (76/78/79) not applicable, exit at the waiting position (fixes missing timetable evaluation)
[*]New: auxiliary arrows
[*]Fix: Fonts adjusted
[*]Fix: ticket packs (children are available again and no longer cause an error)
[*]Fix: Railway BFA-BVE
[*]Design changes on the entire map
[*]Internet textures disabled for the moment
[*]Overview CTI changed[/list]

[b]Bus:[/b]
[list][*]New: heating starts automatically at engine start (only on Bremen)
[*]New: additional mirror can be deactivated via CTI & printer (vis_additional mirror)
[*]New: IBISPlus: Previous and following stop announcements can be played on the display by clicking on the stop
[*]New: seats and air conditioning (in front) are now repaintable
[*]New: Reduced template for KI-MAN (BSAG)
[*]Fix: driver views changed
[*]Fix: changed matrix formatting and target text centering
[*]Fix: IBIS Plus shows only 4 stops
[*]Fix: Money is no longer floating in the air
[*]Fix: EvendPC can not be rotated 360 degrees anymore
[*]Fix: Black square under the bus removed
[*]Fix: TFT monitor now shows stop request
[*]Fix: Exterior sliding door no longer opens through mirrors
[*]Fix: Forcefeedback adjusted
[*]Fix: Mesh error of exterior swing door fixed
[*]Fix: people are not in door 3 anymore
[*]Fix: IBIS Plus finish (time)
[*]Fix: Incorrect description, caused by umlauts
[*]Fix: seat texture
[*]Fix: timetable reflection
[*]Fix: Added some symbols in the VDV display
[*]Fix: Buses in the selection window are now the correct size
[*]Fix: rolling noise
[*]Fix: Templates for A23 & A37 to max. 4096 x 2048 reduced
[*]Fix: lift A37[/list]

notes.title: New Update for OMSI 2
notes.content:
The new [b]OMSI 2[/b] Update includes a small tool (OMSI 2 Patch Changer.exe) in your Steam/OMSI root directory. With this tool, you can switch between the latest and the previous patch level (2.3.003) of [b]OMSI[/b] before you start the game. With this update and the previous version of [b]OMSI 2[/b] made available again this way, you can circumvent issues with the add-on Tram NF6D, among others, that were introduced with the latest patch. Please note, though, that problems of the old patch will come up again, of course – especially issues with the bi-articulated bus.

As usual, the update will be automatically applied via Steam. You have to select the version you want manually, then. Have fun!

notes.title: OMSI 2.2.032 – Update
notes.content: The new update 2.2.032 for OMSI 2 is available. The following things changed: Defective spawn of AI vehicles, their landing behaviour and the collision detection has been improved. Entrypoint listings of wrong maps and range errors for OMSI 1 maps, e.g. the map Neuendorf, have been corrected. Further errors on the map and a possible cause for activation issues with add-ons on Steam have been remedied with this patch as well. For more information, check out the OMSI forums. [url=http://www.omnibussimulator.de/forum/]>>Link<<[/url]

notes.title: OMSI 2.2.021 – Update
notes.content:
The Developer team has worked on some substantial improvements: Now passengers sitting in a vehicle part that has no exits now properly leave their section and move to another one and the bug, that reduced the calculated special vehicle density many times over, has been fixed. Furthermore the probability of special vehicles (fire department, transporters) on Spandau has been reduced to 20% of the previous value.

[url=http://www.omnibussimulator.de/forum/index.php?page=Thread&postID=573847#post573847] Link[/url]

notes.title: Erstes OMSI 2 Update
notes.content:
Die Version 2.00.006 für OMSI 2 kommt mit einigen Bugfixes und Neuigkeiten. In dem Update werden nun die Fahrplanauswertungsfenster korrekt dargestellt sowie Maßnahmen gegen die ODE-Zugriffsfehler ergriffen. Das Fahrplanauswertungsfenster erscheint nicht mehr, wenn im Gelenkbus zwischen den Wagenteilen gewechselt wird.

Weitere Bugfixes:
[list]
[*]Fahrplanauswertungsfenster wird korrekt dargestellt
[*]Fahrplanauswertungsfenster erscheint nicht mehr, wenn man im Gelenkbus zwischen den Wagenteilen wechselt
[*]Maßnahmen gegen die ODE-Zugriffsfehler ergriffen
[*]Es wird wieder gespeichert, ob das Lenkrad aktiv ist
[*]Problem mit der Matrix/Rollband-Initialisierung in Grundorf (keine Fahrgäste steigen ein) gelöst
[*]Fahrgäste im Nachläufer beschweren sich ebenfalls über schlechten Fahrstil (und steigen ggf. aus)
[*]Sicherheitsmechanismus: Bei schlechten Framerates ggf. laden der Minimaloptionen, bei Abstürzen ggf. Abschaltung des Multithreadings
[*]Repaint-Vorlagen
[*]Von fahrenden KI-Fahrzeugen kann der Fokus weggewechselt werden
[*]Größere Entrypoints, die auch für GNs geeignet sind
[*]"Fahrzeug hat ungültige Fahrzeugdaten"-Meldung sollte nicht mehr auftreten (Fehlmeldung)
[*]Prüfung auf Vollständigkeit von Objekten und Splines und konkrete Fehlermeldung
[*]Kleinere Fehlerkorrekturen auf der Spandau-Karte
[*]Weitere Maßnahme gegen Fehler bei erneutem Laden einer Karte ergriffen
[/list]
